types.name: RLightning

fields.name: boltsAlloc
fields.comment: medium: MSVC std::vector<Bolt*> (16 bytes: allocator, first, last, end): AddBolt a0400 takes LEA this+0x4 -> a0390 (push_back/insert). PS2 GCC vector at +0x4..+0x10 (12 bytes), hence +4 on Xbox from +0x14. Name invented

fields.name: boltsFirst
fields.comment: high: ctor a02e0 zeroes +0x8/+0xc/+0x10; dtor 9fec0 frees [+0x8] with size (end-first)>>2<<2 (4-byte elements), then zeroes all three; ClearAllBolts/Draw/Update/IsBoltAlive iterate it. PS2 +0x4 (FindBoltByHandle, ClearAllBolts). Name invented

fields.name: boltsLast
fields.comment: high: vector last: ctor/dtor, ClearAllBolts, Draw, IsBoltAlive, Update. PS2 +0x8. Name invented

fields.name: boltsEnd
fields.comment: high: vector end of storage: dtor 9fec0 uses [+0x10]-[+0x8] as the freed size. PS2 +0xc (~RLightning). Name invented

fields.name: nextBoltHandle
fields.comment: medium: Reset 9fe30 sets 1; AddBolt/AddRoundedBolt read/write it = PS2 +0x10 (AllocBoltHandle, Reset). Name invented

fields.name: lastSimTick
fields.comment: low: Reset 9fe30 stores global 0x234e34 (sim tick); Update 9fb90 R/W. PS2 +0x14 (Reset, Update). Name invented

fields.name: randomNumIndex

types.comment: Lightning bolt renderer singleton. Size 0x700 from Init 8b930 (operator new 0x700, pointer to global 0x200f4c). Base USingleton (vptr only: ~RLightning 9fec0 restores USingleton vtable 0x18beb0 last). Vptr at +0 on both builds; Xbox +4 from +0x14 to +0x4c (MSVC vector 16 vs GCC 12), 0 from the 16-aligned random tables at +0x50 up to material +0x660, then -0x30 (PS2 +0x6f0 = Xbox +0x6c0) with one packed bool.

types.comment: Lighting singleton. Size 0x3f0 from Init 8b620 (operator new 0x3f0, pointer to global 0x1ec260). Base USingleton (~RLightManager 7e8c0 restores 0x18beb0). Vptr +0 on both builds, padded to 16 on Xbox; same offsets to +0x6c, -4 after the two packed bools (+0x6c/+0x6d), -8 after the next two (+0x2c4/+0x2c5). dbattrib names from strings 0x191670..0x191780 (group 'Render:Lighting').

types.comment: Player-car weapon manager. No vptr. Size 0x180 from GameLoop_StartUp 5b0d0 (operator new 0x180, ctor bb220, pointer to global 0x23923c). Same offsets as PS2 to +0x20; six bools pack at +0x24..+0x29 (PS2 4 bytes each), so +0x10 lower than PS2 from +0x2c on (PS2 +0x188 = Xbox +0x178).
